name: An accepted requirement change recalculates the exact outcome once and honours disabled queued alerts
description: Focused deterministic journey; explicit reusable Python assertions are stored alongside this authored plan. Isolated labelled fixtures only for source mutations.

planSteps.description: Sign in isolated operator VAR_{operator_email} with VAR_{password}; select Eligibility and notifications in Isolated source verification, publish valid snapshot to establish target-level master.

Using a separate authenticated browser context for VAR_{other_email} with the same configured secret, save complete matching basics with target master and save [TEST ONLY] Controlled change scholarship. Enable change/in-app notifications and disable email. Update matches to completion.
Assert current evaluation eligible for this controlled fully mapped requirement. As operator publish changed requirement (bachelor) through actual policy pipeline.

Process bounded application jobs. Assert the student evaluation now not_eligible with exact leaf reason VALUE_NOT_ACCEPTED and current profile/scholarship/engine context; exactly one change notification for the accepted version.
Replay the changed snapshot and process jobs; assert unchanged version and exactly one same event alert.
Publish valid reverse change, disable student change topic before processing queued jobs, then process to drain. Assert no reverse-version notification. Restore change preference.
